note: Attribute definitions of the Architecture Metamodel: the fields every instance carries (core_fields) and each entity type's own attributes. Source, reasoning, verification and confidence per attribute. Not yet enforced by sdem-graph check (next build); export-conventions.json keys must all appear here (test).
confidence_rule:
high   — defined by a public standard and checked (BIAN public material, OpenAPI, or a standard concept or
           relationship confirmed by the open-source Archi oracle); or an SDEM data-contract field, which SDEM defines
           authoritatively.
  medium — built on a standard concept or relationship as SDEM chose to model it; or BIAN intent / target only;
           or an SDEM definition, a login-gated source, or a cited-but-unverified source that was validated against
           sealed answers; or institution data under an SDEM convention.
  low    — no standard basis and not validated against sealed answers; or deprecated.

core_fields.name: id
core_fields.description: the instance's permanent key — the source tool's own persistent id
core_fields.reasoning: Every relationship points at it; it must be unique in its level and never reused (knowledge-graph spec KG-I-01).

reference.locator: schema/level-model.schema.json › instance.id; identity rules in docs/knowledge-graph-spec.md §4

core_fields.confidence_basis: SDEM data-contract field, defined authoritatively by SDEM

core_fields.name: type
core_fields.description: an entity type from the catalogue
core_fields.reasoning: Ties the instance to the Architecture Metamodel; must be concrete and of the export's level.

core_fields.name: version
core_fields.reasoning: Relationship ends pin it, so an approved relationship refers to a known state.
